desc:
🐉 FISH AN ANIMAL! 🎣

Cast your rod, reel in a mystery egg and hatch an AWESOME animal! 🥚✨

🐟 Fish eggs straight out of the water
🐣 Hatch them on your very own dock
💰 Your animals earn cash for you, even while you're offline!
📖 Collect 150+ animals: whales, dragons, phoenixes, unicorns and more!

🎁 CODES 🎁
🔑 UPDATE

🧬 NEW: MUTATION MACHINE 🧬
Mutate your animals into Frozen, Toxic, Molten or Galaxy, or get super lucky and hit the JACKPOT! Your first mutation is FREE! 🎰

⭐ Find super rare Golden and Rainbow animals
🌙 Night and 🌧️ rain bring out special animals
🍀 Cast into Luck Pools for bonus luck and rarer eggs
⚓ Hire a crew to fish for you
🎣 Unlock 25 fishing rods for better luck
🔁 Rebirth to earn even faster
🎁 Daily rewards, free gifts and wheel spins
🤝 Trade with friends and fish together for extra luck!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards!

🔔 Follow the game for updates and new codes!
👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to support the game!
